description: This file defines the TokenParser class used for parsing PHP tokens to identify namespaces, use statements, and class declarations within PHP source files. It is a part of Drupal's component annotations for Doctrine integration.

classes.name: TokenParser
classes.description: A class that parses PHP source code tokens to extract namespace, use statements, and class names.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Retrieves the next non-whitespace, non-comment token, optionally considering doc comments as comments.

methods.name: parseUseStatement
methods.description: Parses a single 'use' statement to extract class names and aliases.

methods.name: parseUseStatements
methods.description: Collects all 'use' statements within a given namespace.

methods.name: parseNamespace
methods.description: Extracts the namespace name from tokens.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Identifies the class name, which is tokenized similarly to namespace names.
